title: AutoPay Record Share in PracticePay Patient Financing Late-Fee Relief
content:
**Rule.** The AutoPay share of a late-fee relief on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan counts the AutoPay debits credited on the plan that did not come back: fewer than 1 gives 0.9, 1 up to one below 5 gives 0.95, and 5 or more gives 1.

The count is the AutoPay payment entries credited on the plan over its whole life less those that came back as returned payments; payments made by any other channel (online, phone, debit card, check) are not counted.

| AutoPay debits credited that did not come back | AutoPay share |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0.9 |
| 1, 2, 3 or 4 | 0.95 |
| 5 or more | 1 |

*Example (hypothetical).* A plan with six AutoPay debits credited, one of which came back, counts 5: share 1. A plan with two AutoPay debits, both of which came back, counts 0: share 0.9.
